title: NEO-6M GPS Rocket Recovery System
summary: Arduino-based GPS recovery beacon for hobby rocketry, transmitting live position after apogee for fast payload recovery.
problem: Recovering a rocket airframe after flight is difficult without live location data, especially over open terrain with dense vegetation.
solution: Built a lightweight recovery module around a NEO-6M GPS module and Arduino, logging and transmitting position data through descent so the airframe could be tracked and recovered quickly after landing.
